queries.text: "vadias" rendered as "tramps", which, like the Portuguese word, means both an idle vagrant and (pejoratively) a loose woman; footnote 2 relies on the "idle person" sense. Alternatives: "loose women", "sluts" (loses the "idle" sense), "good-for-nothings".
Camilo Castelo Branco’s novel "Amor de Salvação" (1864) has no established English title that I know of; translated as "Love of Salvation". Alternative: "Saving Love".
